messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Marginal maximum likelihood in Stan
parts:
The higher-order autodiffs are not actually part of the
command-structure refactor that we've been talking about.
The point of this particular refactoring is to simplify, make
more consistent, and make more reliable, the interfaces for
RStan and PyStan and CmdStan by bringing functionality
into Stan C++ that can be reused. The reason we don't want
to pile in changes to commands before the refactor is that
we know we'll have to immediately rewrite anything we do now
and that it'll just push back the completion date.

My understanding is that Rob's finished the pull requests
for higher-order autodiff so we should have at least an experimental
second-order soon (it still needs way more testing). Then all
we need is someone with time to implement MML.

- Bob
